xml_structure: <e-flexbox configuration-id="Signature branding"><e-div-block configuration-id="Branding image"></e-div-block><e-flexbox configuration-id="Branding panel"><e-div-block configuration-id="Branding ring"></e-div-block><e-flexbox configuration-id="Branding label"><e-div-block configuration-id="Branding rule"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="Branding eyebrow"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox><e-heading configuration-id="Branding title"></e-heading><e-paragraph configuration-id="Branding lead"></e-paragraph><e-flexbox configuration-id="Branding list"><e-flexbox configuration-id="Branding item 1"><e-paragraph configuration-id="Branding item 1 no"></e-paragraph><e-paragraph configuration-id="Branding item 1 text"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox><e-flexbox configuration-id="Branding item 2"><e-paragraph configuration-id="Branding item 2 no"></e-paragraph><e-paragraph configuration-id="Branding item 2 text"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox><e-flexbox configuration-id="Branding item 3"><e-paragraph configuration-id="Branding item 3 no"></e-paragraph><e-paragraph configuration-id="Branding item 3 text"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox><e-flexbox configuration-id="Branding item 4"><e-paragraph configuration-id="Branding item 4 no"></e-paragraph><e-paragraph configuration-id="Branding item 4 text"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox></e-flexbox><e-button configuration-id="Branding button"></e-button></e-flexbox></e-flexbox>

Branding title.title: Your logo, beautifully placed on every touchpoint.

Branding lead.paragraph: Make your venue unforgettable with custom-branded tableware and service pieces produced with our manufacturing partners.

Branding item 1 text.paragraph: Personalised chinaware with back-stamps and rim decals

Branding item 3 text.paragraph: Custom-printed linens, menus and table accessories

Branding item 4 text.paragraph: Branded buffet signage and display accents

style.Signature branding: padding: 0px; gap: 0px; align-items: stretch; background: var(--on-navy); @media(--tablet){ flex-direction: column; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; }
style.Branding image: width: 50%; min-height: 845px; padding: 0px; background-image: url(https://soharon.co.uk/onora/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/brands-branding-plate.jpg); background-size: cover; background-position: center center; background-repeat: no-repeat; @media(--tablet){ width: 100%; min-height: 520px; } @media(--mobile){ width: 100%; min-height: 360px; }
style.Branding panel: width: 50%; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; gap: 28px; padding: 100px 100px 100px 88px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--on-navy); @media(--tablet){ width: 100%; padding: 88px 40px; } @media(--mobile){ width: 100%; padding: 64px 20px; gap: 24px; }
style.Branding ring: position: absolute; padding: 0px; min-width: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-style: solid; z-index: 0; right: -140px; top: -180px; width: 520px; height: 520px; border-width: 1.2px; border-color: rgba(222,175,87,0.35); @media(--mobile){ right: -300px; }
style.Branding title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 52px; line-height: 56px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #FFFFFF; position: relative; z-index: 1; @media(--tablet){ font-size: 44px; line-height: 48px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 36px; line-height: 40px; }
style.Branding lead: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; line-height: 28px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78); position: relative; z-index: 1;
style.Branding list: position: relative; z-index: 1; flex-direction: column; padding: 0px; gap: 0px; align-items: stretch;
style.Branding item 1: padding: 16px 0px; gap: 18px; align-items: center; border-width: 0px 0px 1px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
style.Branding item 1 no: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 22px; line-height: 27px; color: var(--on-gold-soft);
style.Branding item 1 text: flex-grow: 1; font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; line-height: 20px; color: #FFFFFF;
style.Branding item 2: padding: 16px 0px; gap: 18px; align-items: center; border-width: 0px 0px 1px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
style.Branding item 2 no: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 22px; line-height: 27px; color: var(--on-gold-soft);
style.Branding item 2 text: flex-grow: 1; font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; line-height: 20px; color: #FFFFFF;
style.Branding item 3: padding: 16px 0px; gap: 18px; align-items: center; border-width: 0px 0px 1px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
style.Branding item 3 no: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 22px; line-height: 27px; color: var(--on-gold-soft);
style.Branding item 3 text: flex-grow: 1; font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; line-height: 20px; color: #FFFFFF;
style.Branding item 4: padding: 16px 0px; gap: 18px; align-items: center; border-width: 0px 0px 1px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
style.Branding item 4 no: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 22px; line-height: 27px; color: var(--on-gold-soft);
style.Branding item 4 text: flex-grow: 1; font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; line-height: 20px; color: #FFFFFF;
